name: track-my-happiness
description: TrackMyHappiness — Global parcel tracker mobile app & background AWB notification engine

scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
scripts.vercel:build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix mobile install --legacy-peer-deps && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npm --prefix mobile run export:web
scripts.build:android-apk: npm --prefix mobile exec -- eas build --platform android --profile preview
